user.title: Connect to a Lyr Core
user.description: The Lyr Core is the server every Lyr app talks to (not Lyr Server, which plays the music). It usually listens on port 3000.

data.token: API token (only if the Core has LYR_API_TOKEN set)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Lyr Core there.
error.core_too_old: That Lyr Core is too old for Home Assistant: it has no /api/zones/now-playing. Update the Core first.

abort.already_configured: This Lyr Core is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Lyr Core that was found.
abort.core_too_old: That Lyr Core is too old for Home Assistant. Update the Core first.

play_prompt.name: Play a Liora prompt
play_prompt.description: Ask Liora for music matching a description and play it on this zone. The first track starts in about ten seconds; the rest of the queue follows about a minute later.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: What to play, in your own words.

start_radio.name: Start radio
start_radio.description: Play radio built from an artist, or from the artist playing on this zone now.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: Leave empty to use the artist playing now.

play_search.name: Play from the library
play_search.description: Play the best match in the Lyr library for a name, the way Siri does.

query.name: Name
